messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"APMO","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"APMO","units":[{"chapter":15,"text":"allotted to us from God. Now I guarded in my lot, the west and the south. But the devil went to Adam's lot, where the male creatures were. [For God divided the creatures; all the males he gave to your father and all the females he gave to me.]","source_ref":"15:3"},{"chapter":16,"text":"And the devil spake to the serpent saying, Rise up, come to me and I will tell thee a word","source_ref":"16:1"},{"chapter":16,"text":"whereby thou mayst have profit.\" And he arose and came to him. And the devil saith to him:","source_ref":"16:2"},{"chapter":16,"text":"\"I hear that thou art wiser than all the beasts, and I have come to counsel thee. Why dost thou eat of Adam's tares and not of paradise? Rise up and we will cause him to be cast out of paradise, even","source_ref":"16:3"},{"chapter":16,"text":"as we were cast out through him.\" The serpent saith to him, \"I fear lest the Lord be wroth with","source_ref":"16:4"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 15:3, 16:1, 16:2, 16:3, 16:4.
